reviews.text: This is the best med spa in DFW! The injector Sophia is the absolute sweetest, she is so knowledgeable and skilled in what she does. I received Radiesse and HA Filler and am so pleased with my results, she really took her time to evaluate my face through the process and showing me in the mirror as well.

I had a really great experience at SuA Glow! Everyone was very kind, welcoming, and professional. They took the time to explain the treatment and answer all of my questions, so I felt comfortable throughout the whole process.

I especially appreciated how attentive they were to my concerns and how carefully they recommended the treatment based on my skin. The environment was clean, relaxing, and comfortable, and I never felt rushed or pressured.

Overall, I’m very happy with my experience and would definitely recommend SuA Glow to anyone looking for professional and personalized skincare treatments. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I had an excellent consultation with Sophia at SuA Glow. She took the time to listen carefully, understand my previous cosmetic procedures, and evaluate each of my concerns individually. Instead of recommending a one-size-fits-all treatment, she created a thoughtful, customized plan using an ECM skin booster for my face, a Nefertiti lift for my neck, and Oligio X for my abdomen.

I especially appreciated how clearly Sophia explained the purpose of each treatment and why it was appropriate for that particular area. She is knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely focused on achieving natural-looking results while preserving what already works well. I left feeling confident, informed, and cared for. If you are looking for personalized Korean aesthetic care rather than a standard treatment package, I highly recommend Sophia and SuA Glow.

I’d make it a little warmer and more specific while keeping it natural:

Sophia is the absolute best! She is incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely cares about helping you achieve the results you’re looking for. She takes the time to listen, explain everything clearly, and makes you feel completely comfortable and confident in your treatment plan. I always feel like I’m in excellent hands with her. Highly recommend!

Had a phenomenal consultation with Sophia! I left genuinely excited. She has a deep understanding of anti-aging and skin rejuvenation and you can tell she’s passionate about the science behind it. I typically spend hours doing my own research on regenerative treatments but walked away feeling way more informed after talking with her. Definitely looking forward to starting my treatments here.

This was my first time getting Botox in the U.S. after only having treatments in Korea, so I was a bit nervous. The consultation was so reassuring, and I felt comfortable discussing all of my concerns. The Botox was administered with great care, and I really appreciated the thorough explanation about the touch-up process. Thank you for making the whole experience so comfortable! ❤️

I absolutely loved working with Sophia and Bianca. They both did an amazing job and were incredibly informative throughout the entire process.

I got the Oligio X and Skin Booster treatments done, and even though it’s only my second day, I’m already loving the results!

I first met Sophia during my skin consultation, and she took the time to thoroughly explain everything to me. She was patient, knowledgeable, and made sure I felt comfortable before moving forward.

On the day of the procedure, she walked me through every step, explaining what each treatment was for again, how it would help my skin, and what to expect. She was very detailed, informative, and supportive throughout the entire experience, which made me feel comfortable and reassured.

I had such a great experience and will by my go to skin treatment spot in DFW from now.

I recently received a high-concentration skin booster treatment, and I truly had such a wonderful experience. From the moment I arrived,  Dr. Sophia was warm, professional, and made me feel very comfortable. They carefully explained the procedure and answered all of my questions, which made me feel confident and relaxed throughout the treatment.
After the treatment, my skin looked noticeably more hydrated, radiant, and smooth. The glow was natural and healthy-looking, and my skin texture felt softer and refreshed. I especially loved how my skin looked brighter and more even without needing much makeup.
I’m very happy with my results and really appreciate the care and attention I received here. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for healthy, glowing skin and a professional skincare experience.
I’m also excited to try the new Oligio X treatment next time!

Had an amazing experience at SuA Glow. I was a bit nervous about getting Botox on my jaw and frown lines, but the consultation was so thorough that I felt instantly at ease.

The clinic itself is beautiful, clean, and the staff are professional. The procedure was quick, painless, and the results are so natural. Highly recommend if you want that perfect K-beauty glow!
